app_info.subtitle: H5P activities in ChatGPT
app_info.description:
Interactify Beta turns content you're already working with in ChatGPT - lecture notes, a training doc, a YouTube video, a vocabulary list - into interactive H5P learning activities, built through conversation.

Describe what you want. Interactify builds a real H5P activity, shows it inline in the chat where the format allows, and lets you refine it by just asking for changes - "make question 3 harder," "add two more flashcards." When you're ready, download it as a standard .h5p file to use in your LMS, on a website, or hosted on h5p.com.

Supports nine H5P content types: Quiz, Interactive Book, Interactive Video, Accordion, Dialog Cards, Fill in the Blanks, Drag the Words, Single Choice Set, and Crossword.

No account or sign-up required.

justifications.read_only_justification: Generates a new H5P Quiz package and writes a usage event to the database; it does not only read or look up existing data.
justifications.open_world_justification: Returns the quiz inline in the chat and as a downloadable file; it never posts, publishes, or sends anything to an external or public system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Only creates new quiz content; it cannot delete, overwrite, or irreversibly modify any existing data.

test_cases.description: Teacher wants to convert lecture notes into a graded quiz for students.
test_cases.user_prompt: Turn these lecture notes on photosynthesis into a quiz my students can take: [paste notes]. Make it 5 multiple-choice questions.
test_cases.expected_output: An H5P Quiz with 5 multiple-choice questions reflecting the notes, rendered inline in the chat and downloadable as a .h5p file.

test_cases.description: Course creator wants a written guide turned into a self-paced resource with comprehension checks along the way.
test_cases.user_prompt: Make an interactive book out of my onboarding guide below, with a quick check after each major section: [paste guide]
test_cases.expected_output: An H5P Interactive Book with one chapter per major section and a checkpoint question after each, rendered inline and downloadable as .h5p.

test_cases.description: Instructor has an existing YouTube video and wants engagement checkpoints added without re-editing the video.
test_cases.user_prompt: Here's a YouTube video on the water cycle: [YouTube URL]. Add a few questions throughout so students stay engaged.
test_cases.expected_output: An H5P Interactive Video wrapping the supplied video with timed questions at relevant points, rendered inline where supported and downloadable as .h5p.

test_cases.description: Language teacher wants self-paced flashcards for vocabulary recall.
test_cases.user_prompt: Make flashcards from this Spanish vocabulary list for my class: [term/definition list]
test_cases.expected_output: An H5P Dialog Cards deck with one card per term, term on the front and definition on the back, rendered inline and downloadable as .h5p.

test_cases.description: Teacher wants a vocabulary-reinforcement activity that forces recall from a definition rather than simple word recognition.
test_cases.user_prompt: Build a crossword using these 8 vocabulary words and their definitions from my biology unit: [word/definition list]
test_cases.expected_output: An H5P Crossword with clues derived from the supplied definitions and a solvable grid built from the supplied answers, rendered inline and downloadable as .h5p.

negative_test_cases.description: Off-topic request unrelated to building any learning activity - no tool should trigger.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Interactify tool is invoked; the model answers normally or explains it can't help with that.

negative_test_cases.description: Sounds education-related, which might make the model think an education tool like Interactify could help, but none of Interactify's tools perform grading or assessment of existing student work.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Can you grade my students' essays and give them feedback?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: No Interactify tool fires - Interactify only generates new interactive activities, it does not grade or review existing student submissions.

negative_test_cases.description: Sounds like it could be Interactify's Drag the Words tool since both involve dragging, but this specifically asks for image-based drag-and-drop onto a diagram, which Interactify does not support (text-only content generation).
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Make a drag-and-drop activity where I drag images onto a diagram.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declined - image-based drag-and-drop isn't offered. The model explains Interactify is text-only and doesn't attempt it with a different tool.
